entries.name: Voice: Granny Edna — loved
entries.prompt: Granny Edna chuckles warmly. "Oh dear, that takes me back."

entries.name: Voice: Granny Edna — evacuated
entries.prompt: Granny Edna marches out muttering about manners.

entries.name: Voice: Granny Edna — intro
entries.prompt: Oh, hello dearie! Granny Edna's here for the show. Do be gentle with an old lady's nose.

entries.name: Voice: Toddler Birthday Party — loved
entries.prompt: The toddlers SHRIEK with laughter and demand cake.

entries.name: Voice: Toddler Birthday Party — evacuated
entries.prompt: Parents whisk their toddlers away, glaring at you.

entries.name: Voice: Toddler Birthday Party — intro
entries.prompt: It's my BIRTHDAY! Do the funny noise! DO THE FUNNY NOISE!

entries.name: Voice: Baby Shower — loved
entries.prompt: The Baby Shower goes silent, then erupts in genteel applause.

entries.name: Voice: Baby Shower — evacuated
entries.prompt: The Baby Shower relocates to "somewhere more peaceful."

entries.name: Voice: Baby Shower — intro
entries.prompt: Welcome to the baby shower! Keep it cute, keep it classy, and mind the gift table.

entries.name: Voice: Kindergarten Class — loved
entries.prompt: The kindergartners erupt in giggles. A spontaneous dance breaks out.

entries.name: Voice: Kindergarten Class — evacuated
entries.prompt: The teacher leads the kindergartners away muttering.

entries.name: Voice: Kindergarten Class — intro
entries.prompt: Hi mister fart scientist! We promise we won't laugh. Okay, we'll laugh a LOT.

entries.name: Voice: Pet Rescue Volunteers — loved
entries.prompt: The dogs wag tails. The volunteers smile. Net donations spike.

entries.name: Voice: Pet Rescue Volunteers — evacuated
entries.prompt: The pets are removed for their own safety.

entries.name: Voice: Pet Rescue Volunteers — intro
entries.prompt: Welcome to the rescue shelter! The puppies are SO excited. Nothing too scary, please!

entries.name: Voice: The Frat Bros — loved
entries.prompt: THE FRAT BROS HOLLER. BEER GETS SPILLED. SOMEONE YELLS 'LEGEND!'

entries.name: Voice: The Frat Bros — evacuated
entries.prompt: The Frat Bros stagger to the parking lot, swearing off you forever.

entries.name: Voice: The Frat Bros — intro
entries.prompt: YOOOO, the bros are HERE! Let's GO, dude! Show us something LEGENDARY!

entries.name: Voice: Goth Teens — loved
entries.prompt: The Goth Teens nod slowly, almost smiling. "Sick."

entries.name: Voice: Goth Teens — evacuated
entries.prompt: The Goth Teens vanish into the shadows, more disappointed than ever.

entries.name: Voice: Goth Teens — intro
entries.prompt: Ugh. We're here, I guess. Whatever. Try not to be boring like everything else.

entries.name: Voice: Alien Tourists — loved
entries.prompt: The Alien Tourists emit synchronized chirps of delight.

entries.name: Voice: Alien Tourists — evacuated
entries.prompt: The Alien Tourists beam back to their ship.

entries.name: Voice: Alien Tourists — intro
entries.prompt: Greetings, Earth specialist. We traveled forty light-years for your famous gas. Begin the demonstration.

entries.name: Voice: Wrestling Fans — loved
entries.prompt: THE WRESTLING FANS GO ABSOLUTELY UNHINGED. CHANTS START.

entries.name: Voice: Wrestling Fans — evacuated
entries.prompt: The Wrestling Fans riot. They were going to anyway.

entries.name: Voice: Wrestling Fans — intro
entries.prompt: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN... welcome to the MAIN EVENT! Bring! The! THUNDER!

entries.name: Voice: Punk Rock Show — evacuated

entries.name: Voice: Punk Rock Show — intro
entries.prompt: OI! You're on! This crowd waits for NOBODY, so make it LOUD!

entries.name: Voice: The Skunk Society — loved

entries.name: Voice: The Skunk Society — evacuated

entries.name: Voice: The Skunk Society — intro
entries.prompt: The Skunk Society convenes. We are connoisseurs of fine aromas. Impress our professional noses.

entries.name: Voice: Food Critics — evacuated

entries.name: Voice: Food Critics — intro
entries.prompt: We are the Food Critics. We have tasted everything. Surprise us... if you dare.

entries.name: Voice: The Volcano Cult — loved

entries.name: Voice: The Volcano Cult — evacuated
entries.prompt: The Volcano Cult retreats to the caldera, plotting.

entries.name: Voice: The Volcano Cult — intro
entries.prompt: The Volcano Cult gathers, o gassy one. The Magma God hungers for a worthy offering.

entries.name: Voice: The Haunted Mansion — loved
entries.prompt: Spectral wails of approval echo through the halls.

entries.name: Voice: The Haunted Mansion — evacuated
entries.prompt: Even the ghosts pack up and haunt elsewhere.

entries.name: Voice: The Haunted Mansion — intro
entries.prompt: Woooooo... the mansion stirs... entertain ussss, or join usssss...

entries.name: Voice: Librarians — loved

entries.name: Voice: Librarians — evacuated
entries.prompt: The Librarians file a formal complaint and leave.

entries.name: Voice: Librarians — intro
entries.prompt: Shhh. The library is now in session. Quietly impress us... if you can.

entries.name: Voice: The Royal Court — loved

entries.name: Voice: The Royal Court — evacuated
entries.prompt: The Royal Court flees the hall, demanding the architect.

entries.name: Voice: The Royal Court — intro
entries.prompt: The Royal Court has arrived. You may begin... when the trumpets finish. Impress us.

entries.name: Voice: The Opera House — evacuated
entries.prompt: The Opera House files out, demanding a refund and a duel.

entries.name: Voice: The Opera House — intro
entries.prompt: Ahh, the Opera House awaits. We expect range. We expect drama. We expect... perfection, darling.

entries.prompt: The Astronauts radio back: "ZERO-G OBSERVATION, IMPRESSIVE."

entries.name: Voice: Astronauts — evacuated
entries.prompt: The Astronauts initiate emergency cabin recycling.

entries.name: Voice: Astronauts — intro
entries.prompt: Mission control, we are go for launch. Repeat: we are GO for launch.

entries.name: Voice: Silent Monks — loved
entries.prompt: The Silent Monks meditate more deeply. A subtle nod.

entries.name: Voice: Silent Monks — evacuated
entries.prompt: The Silent Monks silently file out, leaving a trail of regret.

entries.name: Voice: Silent Monks — intro
entries.prompt: The monks have taken their seats. We shall judge... in complete silence.

entries.name: Voice: The Mystery Guest — loved
entries.prompt: The Mystery Guest gives a knowing smile. You will never know who they were.

entries.name: Voice: The Mystery Guest — evacuated
entries.prompt: The Mystery Guest vanishes mid-blink.

entries.name: Voice: The Mystery Guest — intro
entries.prompt: Someone has arrived. Who? That is the mystery. Proceed... carefully.
